description: Pass/fail lint for ZPL — machine-readable diagnostics with line/column, code and severity: unknown commands, missing ^FS, out-of-range parameters, fields outside the label. Fast; run it before zpl_preview whenever you generate or edit ZPL. For a human-readable report with a score, use explain_zpl instead.

dpmm.description: Printer density (8 = 203 dpi). The boundary check measures against it — pass the real value.

height_in.description: Label height in inches. Same as width_in: the boundary check depends on it.

width_in.description: Label width in inches. Fields outside it are reported, so a wrong size makes that finding wrong.

name: zpl_validate

message.description: Human-readable message in the requested language

title: Validate ZPL
